reading.title: Office supplies 1: Preparing and organising work
reading.text: Mina prepares notes for an office meeting. She writes with a pen and sketches a plan with a pencil. A highlighter marks an important line, while a marker and whiteboard marker stay beside the board. An eraser helps her change the sketch. Her case holds a mechanical pencil, fountain pen and felt-tip pen. She uses correction tape on a paper copy, then puts her notebook and legal pad beside it. A sticky note marks a page, and an index card holds a question.
reading.imageBrief: A tidy adult office workspace with blank papers and unbranded supplies; visual reference only.

reading.title: Office supplies 2: Preparing and organising work
reading.text: Mina sorts the meeting papers before sending them. She puts a folder in a binder and keeps a manila folder for receipts. A label identifies the envelope. A stapler holds several pages together; a paper clip is enough for a short note. A binder clip and rubber band secure thicker bundles. A pushpin and thumbtack stay on the noticeboard. She keeps tape, a glue stick and a spare fastener in a drawer. A magnet holds the meeting reminder on a metal board.

reading.title: Office supplies 3: Preparing and organising work
reading.text: Mina clears the shared desk. She puts pens in a pencil cup inside the desk organizer and papers in the letter tray. A tape dispenser sits beside the desk lamp. The mouse pad and wrist rest stay near the keyboard; the monitor stand raises the screen and a cable organizer keeps wires together. She checks the desk calendar before preparing a parcel. A shipping label goes on the box. Packing tape closes it, while bubble wrap protects the contents. A stamp is ready for a separate letter.
